title: Multiphysics model for designing magnetic bead collection processes on centrifugal microfluidic platforms
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7481-7495
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09842D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jakob Wimmer, Carole Planchette, Gerhard A. Holzapfel, Theresa Rienmüller
Magnetic bead collection on a lab-on-a-disc is modeled and experimentally validated. A multiphysics framework captures bead aggregation and magnetophoresis-induced convection, enabling rational design of magnetic bead usage in microfluidic systems.
